measureRecords.whatItDoes: Exempts the full assessed value of a qualifying Covington resident’s homestead from city property taxes, including city bond taxes, beginning January 1, 2027 if voters approve. It adds to other city-tax homestead exemptions and does not apply to state, county or school property taxes. The resident or an agent must apply to the city or its designee; the exemption then renews while the home remains the resident’s homestead, and recipients must report loss of eligibility.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the full city-tax homestead exemption for qualifying residents.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed full city-tax homestead exemption.
